Petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking following reliefs :
"10.1
That, this Hon'ble Court kindly be pleased to direct the respondent authorities for following the provision of 14 (2) of the Act of 1957.
10.2 That, this Hon'ble Court kindly be pleased to direct the respondent authorities for depositing the compensation before Tribunal with interest as directed in letter dated 12.05.1989.
10.3 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly direct the respondents for following letter dated 18.09.1998."

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for petitioner submits that land of petitioner was acquired by respondent No. 2 &
3 under the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957 (hereinafter referred as the Act of 1957).

entities.text: Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Pursuant thereto notification was issued on 08.06.2009 under Section 4 (1) of the Act of 1957 and amount of compensation was computed on 17.01.2024.
Petitioner being aggrieved with the amount of compensation computed, submitted representation before respondent No. 2 on 25.07.2024.
However, no decision has been taken on the representation submitted by petitioner.

He submits that if, any of the parties is aggrieved with the amount of compensation determined, then under Section 14 of the Act of 1957 dispute is to be referred to the Tribunal, which, as per his information, is District Judge, Bilaspur with respect to territorial jurisdiction under which land of petitioner comes.

He submits that till date, reference has not been made, therefore, respondent No.
2 be directed to take decision on the representation at the earliest within specified time frame.

3. Mr. Pankaj Agrawal, learned counsel for respondents No. 2 & 3 submits that if, the representation submitted by petitioner is still pending consideration, it will be considered in accordance with law at the earliest.

4. Considering the submission made by learned counsel for respective parties, nature of grievance raised, instead of keeping this writ petition pending, seeking reply from the respondents, I find it appropriate to dispose of the same directing respondent No. 2 to take decision on the representation submitted by petitioner in accordance with law expeditiously, preferably within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of the order.
5. It is ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
